entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, get me a person. This is unbelievable.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I want to return this VeloBand. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I understand your frustration. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's not a 'preference'! It's impossible. The whole interface is so confusing, and the sensor is incredibly hard to use. I read the user manual cover to cover and it's useless. I expected more from a VeloFit product. A lot more.
I see. I'm very sorry to hear the VeloBand isn't meeting your expectations. Let me just pull up your order details to see what our options are. Can I get your name and order number?

The name is Sam Jones, order 8675309. And don't give me the runaround. If you can't process a simple return, get me your manager. I am two seconds away from posting a review about this on every fitness blog I can find.
I understand your position, Mr. Jones. There's no need for that, I can help you directly. One moment... Okay, I see your order. You received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor 22 days ago.
And? Are you going to tell me I'm a day late or some other nonsense?
Not at all, sir. I'm just confirming the details. According to our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, what? Ninety days? Are you sure?
Yes, I'm sure. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days from delivery. I can go ahead and authorize this return for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label.
Huh. Well, alright then. That's... actually what I wanted. Fine. Send the label.

Of course. The email is on its way to you now. Just pack the item back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund in 3-5 business days. Was there anything else?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
